# markdiff builder reference

This document is produced by markdiff itself. Each section shows the Markdown rendered by one group of builder calls, so changes to rendering show up here as a reviewable diff.

## Text

Paragraphs are trimmed and separated by blank lines.

Rendered Markdown:

```markdown
First paragraph.

Second paragraph with 1 formatted value.
```

## Code blocks

The fence grows past any backtick run in the content, so fenced Markdown can itself be captured.

Rendered Markdown:

`````markdown
```go
fmt.Println("hi")
```

````markdown
```sh
echo nested
```
````
`````

## JSON

Values are encoded as indented JSON without HTML escaping.

Rendered Markdown:

````markdown
```json
{
  "name": "<crush>",
  "tags": [
    "a",
    "b"
  ]
}
```
````

## Lists

Multi-line items stay inside their marker, and empty lists are explicit.

Rendered Markdown:

```markdown
- one
- two
  continued

1. first
2. second

_(none)_
```

## Tables

Short rows are padded; pipes and newlines in cells are escaped.

Rendered Markdown:

```markdown
| Input | Result |
| --- | --- |
| a\|b | line one<br>line two |
| short |  |
```

## Diffs

Before and after text is shown as a unified diff, or a note when nothing changed.

Rendered Markdown:

````markdown
```diff
--- before
+++ after
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 alpha
-beta
+gamma
```

_(no differences)_
````

## Quotes and details

Quotes prefix every line; details wrap long supporting output.

Rendered Markdown:

````markdown
> Error: something went wrong
>
> Try again.

<details>
<summary>Full log</summary>

```text
line 1
line 2
```

</details>
````

## Nested sections

Each nested section is one heading level deeper than its parent.

Rendered Markdown:

```markdown
### Child

A child section.

#### Grandchild

A grandchild section.
```
